For example, a platform moored in 850m depth water could not have a 900m or 1000m deep CW intake pipe because the water is not deep enough at that location. The possible selections for the CW Intake depth are from 300m to 1000m in 100m increments, as long as the water is deep enough for the open end of the CW intake piping to be at least 30m from the seafloor to avoid ingestion of wildlife or disturbing the seafloor. Input: OTEC Facility Size and Configuration There are three different OTEC facility sizes to choose from in the interactive model: • 100kW Hull Integrated with one 0.5m diameter cold water intake pipe • 1.0 MW Add-On with one 1.6m diameter cold water intake pipe • 3.9 MW Add-On with one 3.25m diameter cold water intake pipe.
